title: PlanetaryMC
description: PlanetaryMC is a vanilla, semi-plugin enhanced SMP experience designed for players who love the simplicity of Minecraft while enjoying carefully selected QOL features.
body:
🚀 Welcome to PlanetaryMC! 🪐

PlanetaryMC is a vanilla, semi-plugin enhanced SMP experience designed for players who love the simplicity of Minecraft while enjoying carefully selected QOL features. We stay true to the core survival gameplay you know and love, without overwhelming players with excessive custom content.

🌟 What We Offer
- Vanilla-focused survival gameplay
- Plugin-enhanced features that improve the experience without changing Minecraft’s core feel
- Player-driven block based economy and community interactions
- Clans
- Cross-platform support for both Java & Bedrock players
- Dedicated staff and active development
- Long-term worlds built for exploration and progression

Whether you’re building an empire, exploring with friends, forming a clan, or creating massive projects, PlanetaryMC delivers the proper Minecraft experience with just the right enhancements to make every session more enjoyable.
